mods.name: Portable Crafting Compat
mods.description: General compatibility add-on for Portable Crafting: use modded workstations (Uncraft Everything, Precise Enchanting and more) straight from your inventory.

releases.notes:
First release of Portable Crafting Compat for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric).

### Supported workstations
- **Uncraft Everything**: Uncrafting Table
- **Precise Enchanting**: Arcane Disenchanter

Hold the workstation in your hand and right-click to use it without placing it.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.16.9+, Fabric API
- Portable Crafting
- Uncraft Everything and/or Precise Enchanting (optional)

Install on both client and server. Tested in singleplayer.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoreRous/portable-crafting-compat/commits/v1.0.0
